title: Chromatic Chalier - Location, Weakness & Rewards
description: Chromatic Chalier in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Chromatic form of Chalier. Light is the weakness and Dark is resisted, which makes it one of the fights where a Dark-heavy Sciel build is actively worse than a Light line.

sections.title: Where to Find the Chromatic Chalier
sections.content:
Location: Sinister Cave, The Continent.

Availability: Act 2.

Chromatic enemies are optional, supercharged versions of an enemy you already fought. They are not required for the story, but they drop the better tier of materials and the weapons tied to their base enemy.

Bring Light damage. Dark is resisted, so those turns are wasted.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
• Higher-tier Chroma materials than the base Chalier
  • Weapons and Pictos gated behind defeating the Chromatic Chalier

Exact drop quantities for this encounter are not documented in the sources we could verify, so they are not listed rather than estimated.

sections.title: How to Beat the Chromatic Chalier
sections.content:
Same answer as the base enemy

The Chromatic Chalier keeps the weaknesses and resistances of the ordinary Chalier. If you have already fought the base version, your party does not need to change - what changes is the margin for error.

What actually kills you

Chromatic variants hit harder and hold more health than the enemy they are based on. The failure mode is almost always running out of resources mid-fight rather than a mechanic you did not understand, so bring healing headroom rather than a greedier damage build.
